name: A Word from Saga Telecom.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
In EACH datasheet, there is a link on the bottom exactly the same as below.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10pI-PIGftC6UVEngjg_cLlC8-X14fA9A?usp=drive_link
You will be directed to a folder(Name: MUST KNOW)
There are many files in it.
If you have some time, you could read them one by one.
Or
Open “PROFILE” directly to know us.
On page 14, there are some links to each product category.
Click and you will be directed to the product information.
This is our design.
As long as a client gets one of our datasheets, there is an access to all of this.
However, we notice that
Many clients come to us just for prices&datasheet, that is all.
No further discussion nor interest in learning our business mode.
Honestly we do not want to waste our time on such clients.
Our policy is, serve a few loyal, patient and professional clients with attention.
We think
If a client does not spend some time on the company profile he is going to cooperate with, how possible he gets the right products/solutions with ease?
As we stated in EACH datasheet, we do simplified, standard, solution based business.
We like to focus on those clients who truly care about healthy, professional, long-term cooperation.
Get to know us first and throw questions, we take care of it timely.
Gradually a pattern is formed, both sides know how to communicate effectively, when to expect a reply, what support we could give etc.
In the meantime, we do “3C”
Connecting, Converting, Creating
Saga Telecom connects talents and ideas that may drive itself forward
Saga Telecom converts mature business system to all-round growth
Saga Telecom creates betterness from expertise and solution package
We have been working hard to learn better things from clients, peer brands and self-reflection.
Please do let us know if we can improve in any way.
Saga Telecom aims to be a marathoner in fiber optic telecommunication field, please join us to embrace value and growth.

Built to Last, Continuous Supply, Evolving Together
